additional_info.body:
Hi Simen, good morning.
I checked the time you provided and it was the CET time, the provided one.
Here is the root cause:
When you see this stack_started, it means that the EcoG didn't start the process correctly. After a reboot, this gets fixed. If you have SSH access you can reboot the EcoG remotely.
I see multiple sessions being started afterwards, so it might be that the reboot was not even necessary, it might've been just a temporary issue:
It seems like the problem is resolved so I will close the ticket.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
